steps.name: verify grudging donation after fresh reload
do: Runner.badIndex=quest:ReadGlobalGameData(1248); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==3 and quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==2); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook') and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence()); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==(i<2 or i==Runner.badIndex),name..'['..i..']') end end; for _,i in ipairs({0,1,Runner.badIndex}) do assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,i),quest:GetHero()),'donated inventory still present') end; Runner.badLoaded=true
